 Parks &  Recreation Commission  Minutes
January 21, 2025

  Holiday Extravaganza had a great response with food vendors, parade
  entries and non -profits and wrist band sales, There was a delay with the
  snow slide delivery and will address issue to no reoccur for next year.

  Chair Bartolo asked for clarification for the lack of school band
  involvement.  Mr. Jones confirmed that we did not receive a parade entry
  form from the high school, will continue to reach out to: high school in the
  future, There may be some scheduling conflict due to high school band
  competition  season.

  Chair Biartolo asked for an update on the holiday decoration contest. Mr.
  Jones confirmed next year commission will be notified with time to assist
  with the holiday decorating contest,

  Commission requested to include in the future Halloween House
  decorating contest to the Halloween event.

  Chair Bartolo recognized the great efforts and work that goes into the special events
  and asked for any updates due to the current windy weather. Mr. Jones stated on
  only 2 trees that he was aware had been affected due to the weather.

  Commissioner Tsang commented on the Holiday Extravaganza it was wonderful
  2nd had a good time.
